access_evidence: open.canada.ca CKAN package fe1dfbb9-0fc3-42ca-b2a9-6ca4c05dbac9 resolves 152 resources; 8 range files downloaded and SHA-256 recorded in DATASETS/patents/cipo_canada/raw/PROVENANCE.json.
blockers: Snapshot only: bibliographic extract ends 2022-02-28, so no record-level history.
No publication / open-to-inspection date field; only Filing Date and Grant Date.
opic-cipo.ca serves an incomplete TLS chain (omits intermediate).
licence_note: Open Government Licence - Canada. Quoted: 'grants you a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence to use the Information, including for commercial purposes'. Attribution required: 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada'.
machine_interface: CKAN catalogue -> zipped CSV range files (8 tables, 2 splits each)
name: CIPO Patent bulk data (PT_Main / PT_Interested_Party / PT_IPC / PT_Priority)
notes: Do NOT apply the 18-month laid-open rule as a date. Pending applications get source_public_at = NULL + MISSING_PUBLICATION_DATE.
rate_policy: CKAN API returned 429 once; connector backs off 4x with sleeps
robots_summary: not retrieving documents by crawler; bulk archives fetched from catalogue-listed URLs
unlock_route: TLS: intermediate obtained from the leaf's AIA caIssuers URL and added to a bundle (hz.tls.complete_chain); verification is still enforced. Freshness: CIPO states the dataset is refreshed quarterly through IP Horizons, so a newer extract can be picked up from the same catalogue record when published.
what_is_new: Second jurisdiction AND an explicit open licence. Uniquely carries an ownership timeline (Owner Enable Date / Ownership End date) per party, which is exactly what historical subsidiary-vs-parent attribution needs.
